notes.title: Playtest soon!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

It's finally time. There will be an open playtest next weekend for Nox Mortalis. Everyone can take part!


Playtest starts:
Friday, May 16, 6:00 PM (GMT+1)

Playtest ends:
Monday, May 19, 6:00 PM (GMT+1)


Important notes:

Wishlist the game if you haven't already
Join the discord to provide feedback and share your thoughts: Discord
The playtest build only contains a small part of the game (it's like an early demo to get feedback)



Best regards,
Gemezl
